notes.title: The Backrooms Simulator v1.1 Release
notes.content:
The update is finally here! The Backrooms Simulator now includes revolutionary features such as:

[list]
[*] Jumping for joy
[*] Flickering lights
[*] Tons of settings
[*] VR enhancements
[*] Improved lighting
[*] Unlockable achievements
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Branch Now Available
notes.content:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ActiveTastyAmurminnow-size_restricted.gif[/img]

In preparation for our upcoming 1.1 patch, we've opened up the beta branch to those who want an early look. 


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KxkVOdm.jpg[/img]

This update includes:
[list]
[*] Jumping
[*] Flickering lights
[*] Retro mode
[*] Many more customization options
[*] [VR] smooth locomotion with snap-turning
[*] [VR] improved Oculus support
[/list]
As it is a beta, there may be mechanics and/or assets missing that will make their way into the final release. Keep that in mind when testing it out :) 

To install the beta update, right click on "The Backrooms Simulator" in your Steam library > Properties Betas > "beta - test branch" [img]https://i.imgur.com/LcZ0abv.png[/img]

Bug reports and feedback can be shared in the beta thread: [url=]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1119430/discussions/0/3276939640765774150/[/url]

notes.title: VR Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
